task_completion.description: Open the 'A simple model rocket' design in OpenRocket.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket application window is visible showing a rocket design with components like Nose Cone, Body Tube, and Fins.

task_completion.description: Apply specific mass overrides to the five required components: Nose Cone (28.5g), Body Tube (38.0g), Trapezoidal Fin Set (12.5g), Parachute (15.0g), and Inner Tube (5.5g).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Component configuration dialogs or the 'Mass Overrides' tab showing the specific numerical values entered for each named component.

task_completion.description: Run a flight simulation to verify stability and apogee.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Flight simulations' tab showing a simulation entry with a green checkmark or a plot/summary window showing stability margin and apogee altitude.

task_completion.description: Save the calibrated design to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or a file manager window showing 'calibrated_simple_rocket.ork' in the '~/Documents/rockets/' directory.

task_completion.description: Create a mass properties report text file with all required data points.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing 'mass_properties_report.txt' containing a table of masses, CG location, stability margin, and apogee.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to modify components rather than just writing files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with OpenRocket component edit windows and override checkboxes.

integrity.description: The flight data in the report matches the simulation results in the GUI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The apogee and stability values visible in the OpenRocket 'Flight simulations' table match the values written in the text report.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create the report file without opening the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the progression from opening the app, to editing components, to running the simulation, then saving.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required mass overrides are: Nose Cone: 28.5g, Body Tube: 38.0g, Trapezoidal Fin Set: 12.5g, Parachute: 15.0g, Inner Tube: 5.5g. The output files must be exactly at /home/ga/Documents/rockets/calibrated_simple_rocket.ork and /home/ga/Documents/exports/mass_properties_report.txt. A tolerance of 2.0g is acceptable for mass verification.
